cover_headline: GalaxEye Awards Bellatrix Aerospace Propulsion Contract for Its Next 30 Satellites

end.headline: GalaxEye Awards Bellatrix Aerospace Propulsion Contract for Its Next 30 Satellites
end.line: Bellatrix will supply Arka propulsion systems for GalaxEye's next 30 Drishti Gen-II satellites.

facts: GalaxEye has awarded Bellatrix Aerospace a multi-year contract to supply Arka electric propulsion systems for its next 30 Drishti Gen-II satellites
Deliveries begin with systems for the first two satellites, and GalaxEye aims to deploy the constellation by 2030
Bellatrix raised $20 million in a pre-Series B round in March 2026, and GalaxEye has secured a commitment of ₹63.84 crore from the Technology Development Board

quote.speaker: Pranit Mehta
quote.text: The Indian private ecosystem is here and now, and it is time that we partner with each other and not just rely on the government.
